Ian — thanks for the clear list. We can definitely consolidate. I'll own delivery and loop in Markus and Marissa for the ops and TAM details. High-level commitments below; I'll attach a consolidated playbook draft by EOD 09/14 for your review.

High-level commitments:
- TAM coverage: named TAMs for Dedicated and Private customers; 9×5 standard, 24×7 coverage available via on-call rotation for Sev1 incidents on enterprise contracts.
- Escalation matrix: 3-tier escalation (TAM -> Escalations Engineer -> Platform SRE lead) with SLA ping escalation windows.
- MTTR targets: Sev1 initial response 15 min, containment target 2 hours (platform-dependent), full remediation target depends on root cause; we provide interim mitigation steps and regular updates.
- Incident comms: templated notifications, dedicated Slack channel or bridge, and encrypted evidence upload to customer S3 or secure drive per contract.

Next steps:
1) Markus to provide escalation names and 24×7 on-call roster.
2) Marissa to add SOC2 evidence flow and compliance notes.
3) I will assemble the playbook and share the Drive link.

Regards,
Olga Petrov

Folks — pushing the roster and escalation matrix below so Olga can stitch into the playbook. I've redacted phone numbers for the version that goes into procurement; we can provide direct numbers once NDA/comm channel is established.

Escalation matrix (summary):
- TAM (first responders): 09:00–17:00 customer local time, primary contact + backup TAM (2-hour SLA for non-critical).
- Escalations Engineer (EE): 24×7 on-call for Sev1 via paging system, first ack within 15 minutes.
- Platform SRE lead: paged if incident not contained within containment window (2 hours) or customer requests executive-level update.
- Executive escalation: Director-level engagement within 4 business hours upon customer request.

TAM roster (redacted):
- Primary TAM: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — coverage hours 9×5 (PST)
- Backup TAM: Dylan Brooks (dylan.brooks@redwood.ai) — on-call rotation for off-hours

Also adding standard incident comms cadence we use: initial ack (15 min), incident triage update (30–60 min), hourly status updates until containment, then cadence moves to twice-daily for complex postmortems.

I attach a sanitized TSV of the roster for procurement.
